VEYLET

Support.

Write to Veylet support and a person replies.

Email yoda@yodalai.xyz. Include the space name as it appears in the app or on your account, your phone model, the app build number from About, and what you expected to happen. Never send passwords, access codes or private images by email.

Quick answers.

The app says Needs recapture
Follow the reasons it lists; each names the fix. The failed attempt used no walkthrough. Recapture every room from the original capture to keep the same link and use no extra walkthrough; a capture of only some of the rooms is new, and it uses a walkthrough when accepted.
The sign-in email did not arrive
Check the address you typed and your spam folder, then request a new code. Each code works once.
Your plan, free months or renewal
See your plan in the app. App Store subscriptions are managed in Settings › Subscriptions; the terms say how renewal and cancelling work.
Stopping a shared walkthrough
Pause sharing keeps the same link: within a minute, the link, embed and QR show "not available" until you resume. Turn off sharing stops the link for good, and turning it back on makes a new link. Both are under Manage sharing on the walkthrough’s card in your account.
Reporting someone else’s walkthrough
If a walkthrough shows a person, a document or an item that shouldn’t be seen, or isn’t the property it claims to be, use Report this walkthrough at the foot of its page, or email support with its link. Privacy reports are reviewed within 24 hours. For your own walkthroughs, Pause sharing stops the link at once.
A listing portal or CRM
A live walkthrough’s card has Copy listing URL (portals, CRM). It opens the walkthrough alone, with no agent card, links or QR code, and it can be shown inside another site.
Deleting your account
In the app under Account, or in your account under "Finishing, exporting or leaving". We complete it within 30 days; the privacy notice says what is kept and for how long.
